mentions.name: Helene
mentions.description: This app is a personal memory layer for AI chats that captures conversations with AI across clients (Claude, ChatGPT, desktop, and mobile) and weaves them into documents. Data stays on the user's own Google Drive, and past conversations compound into a hassle-free automated diary while keeping context in sync between desktop and mobile.
mentions.audience: Copies and pastes context between AI sessions across multiple clients and devices was painful, especially between desktop and mobile, and past conversations didn't compound into anything useful.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Helene (https://helene-ai.com), a personal memory layer for AI chats, stored in your Drive.
